ValidationRule.description: For customer/non-customer complaints, checks the 2nd issue is filled in prior to the 3rd issue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint'), AND(IDR_Second_Issue__c = false, IDR_Third_Issue__c = true) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Second Issue Type details are required
